title: Without Delete, the actions menu has no Deactivate parts or Activate parts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a custom role for this test, role B, with Part Library & Inventory — View, Part Library & Inventory — Create & Edit and See Financial Data but without Part Library & Inventory — Delete, so user B can create and edit parts but cannot delete them.
  • Create a staff member for this test, user B, at the test location with role B, so the steps run with role B's permissions.
  • Use two browser windows: window 1 signed in as the Admin, window 2 (a private window) signed in as user B, so both users' screens can be seen side by side.
  • Start both windows on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. In window 1, click the three-dot actions button (⋮).
  2. In window 1, press Escape.
  3. In window 2, click the three-dot actions button (⋮).
  4. In window 2, click Cycle count.
  5. In window 2, click Cancel in the count toolbar.
  6. In window 2, click the Inactive tab.
  7. In window 2, click the three-dot actions button (⋮).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Admin's menu lists Cycle count, Deactivate parts and Export, in that order: the entry exists on this build.

Step 2:

  • The menu closes.

Step 3:

  • User B's menu lists Cycle count and Export only.
  • There is no Deactivate parts entry.

Step 4:

  • Cycle count starts for user B (the count toolbar and Count boxes appear): Cycle count needs nothing more than Create & Edit.

Step 5:

  • The count ends and the toolbar is back to normal.

Step 6:

  • The Inactive tab is selected in window 2.

Step 7:

  • User B's menu lists Cycle count and Export only.
  • There is no Activate parts entry.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions)

  • S8-R3: “A user without that permission does not see the "Deactivate parts" entry in the Inventory actions menu.”
  • S8-R4: “That user does not see the "Activate parts" entry on the Inactive tab.”
  • S8-R5: “The actions menu needs the 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' permission. Its Cycle count and Export entries need nothing more. Only the bulk status entry also needs the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission.”
